description: Premies per gemeente is a dataset listed in Fluvius open data portal, an open data portal of a distribution network operator, published or maintained by Fluvius (Flanders). Het aantal premies per gemeente vind je terug op energiesparen.be. Coverage: Belgium (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Financieel Beheer. Its keywords are Energiesparen. The portal shows 2021-11-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fluvius-open-data-portal.
